annotations.title: Check an invoice for e-invoice readiness

description: Check whether an outgoing invoice (Rechnung) can go out as an e-invoice (E-Rechnung: XRechnung / ZUGFeRD) before finalizing it: your company data (USt-IdNr./Steuernummer, address, IBAN, BIC, e-mail, phone), the customer (name, address, country, e-mail, buyer reference / Leitweg-ID for public authorities, USt-IdNr. for reverse charge and intra-EU supplies), Leistungsdatum, Zahlungsziel, payment method, unit codes of the positions and the tax rule (One-Stop-Shop rules 18–20 are not supported). For a finalized invoice it also reads the XML sevDesk generated and checks it against EN 16931 rules. Read only. Returns ready plus problems and warnings, each with the field and the tool that fixes it (sevdesk_invoice_update_draft, sevdesk_contact_update). Before: sevdesk_invoice_get. After: sevdesk_invoice_finalize.

id.description: Invoice id (not the invoice number), e.g. from sevdesk_invoices_list.
